archetypes.name: issue-trace
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the plan actually covers every issue-described harness gap instead of declaring required coverage out of scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the issue description against the proposed plan and scoped files, looking for named gaps that are missing, weakened, or incorrectly moved out of scope. Pay special attention to strip-failure coverage, probe coverage, review-and-fix dispatch coverage, and any acceptance criteria implied by launcher-argv-test-coverage references. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: auth-isolation
archetypes.rationale: Targets plan defects around auth-mode separation, secret leakage checks, stamps, argv captures, sidecars, and temp CODEX_HOME cleanup.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect whether the plan's auth-path test additions prove env-key and login behavior without leaking sentinel credentials or accepting stale stamps. Check for gaps in argv adjacency assertions, sidecar/log absence checks, fixture auth symlink validation, and cleanup assertions across success, failure, retry, timeout, and fallback paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: fixture-hygiene
archetypes.rationale: Reviews whether proposed harness mechanics are stable, Bash-3.2-compatible, non-vacuous, and isolated from fixture or /tmp pollution.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the proposed test-harness mechanics for brittle assumptions, vacuous assertions, fixture mutation, permission restoration gaps, and concurrent temporary-directory noise. Cross-check that each scoped script has a realistic place to add the described stubs, captures, subshell env handling, and mutation sanity checks without changing production behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
